title: eludite.debug.allow_agents input
description: Debug > Allow Agents to Drive, and the toggle in the status bar while debugging: whether agents may start, attach to, restart, resume and change the debugging session (continue, the steps, run_to_cursor, run_until, trace, pause, stop, set_variable, set_next_statement, tracepoints with expressions). While it is off, every such command from an agent is refused with `agents are not allowed to drive this session (Debug > Allow Agents to Drive)`; reads (snapshot, state, stack, variables, output, exception_info, wait, processes) keep working, and the person's own commands are never affected. It holds for the current session; set while no session runs, it holds for the next one. Each new session starts with the setting debugger.allowAgentsByDefault (true unless changed). Only the person can turn it on: an agent's call with `enabled: true` is refused (an agent may turn it off).

session.description: The debugging session to act on (brief 0028): its `id`, from eludite.debug.sessions or `sessions` in eludite.debug.state. Default: the active session, the one the Locals, Watch, Call Stack and Threads windows show and the execution point follows. Each session has its own switch; set while no session runs, it holds for the next one. An unknown or ended id is refused with the ids of the live sessions.

enabled.description: Allow agents to drive (true) or not (false).
